title: 【RPG Design Guides】Choosing a Development Environment ① Tools

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】開発環境の選択① ツール
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Choosing a Development Environment ① Tools

blocks.source: ※このページは内容が古くて使いものになりません。最新の状況は常に変化していますので、各自で確認してください。
blocks.translation: ※This page is outdated and no longer useful. The current situation is constantly changing, so please check it for yourself.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧを制作するには、もちろん開発環境が必要。具体的には開発ツールもしくはプログラミング言語となる。というわけで、ここでは開発ツールを挙げてみる。
blocks.translation: To create an RPG, you obviously need a development environment. Specifically, this means either a development tool or a programming language. So, here I will introduce some development tools.

blocks.source: （ソフト名で公式HPにリンクしているので、気になったツールは参照のこと。）
blocks.translation: (The software names link to their official websites, so please check out any tools that interest you.)

blocks.source: 長らくＲＰＧ用開発ツールの頂点として君臨し、数々の名作が生み出された。初心者に優しいユーザーインタフェースを持ちながら、豊富な機能で上級者もおおむね満足できる。解像度は320x240と低めだけど、ＳＦＣっぽい雰囲気の作品を作りたいならば、こっちのほうが便利。
blocks.translation: It reigned for a long time as the pinnacle of RPG development tools and produced numerous masterpieces. Its user interface is friendly to beginners, while its wealth of features generally satisfies advanced users as well. The resolution is a rather low 320x240, but if you want to create a game with an SNES-like atmosphere, this one is more convenient.

blocks.source: デフォルト戦闘システムこそ、古臭いフロントビューだが、セラフィックブルーやシルフェイド幻想譚など、システムをスクリプトで自作することで、オリジナリティの高いゲームを作り上げることも可能。また、デフォルト戦闘ではあっても、テーブルトークRPGを参考にシステムを作りあげたRuinaの様に独自性の高い名作も存在する。
blocks.translation: Although its default battle system uses the dated front-view format, it is possible to create highly original games by scripting your own systems, as seen in Seraphic Blue and Sylphid's Illusionary Tales. Even among games using the default battle system, there are highly distinctive masterpieces such as Ruina, whose system was based on tabletop RPGs.

blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧに例えれば、ＳＦＣの大作ＲＰＧクラス・ＤＱ６やＦＦ５、ロマサガ３などのゲームシステムをほぼ再現することも可能。物凄く手間はかかるけど……。
blocks.translation: To compare it to commercial RPGs, it is even possible to almost recreate the game systems of major SNES RPGs such as Dragon Quest VI, Final Fantasy V, and Romancing SaGa 3. It takes an incredible amount of work, though...

blocks.source: 欠点としては、１０年前に発売したソフトであり、今となっては古臭さを否めないこと。かくいう僕も今作成中の作品を最後にツクール2000は卒業したいところ。
blocks.translation: Its drawback is that it was released ten years ago, and its age is impossible to ignore now. As for me, I would like to graduate from RPG Maker 2000 after finishing the game I am currently working on.

blocks.source: 機能はツクール2000に類似。違いはサイドビューの戦闘やダンジョン自動生成機能など。元々はバグだらけで酷評の嵐だったが、度重なるアップデートによって、一応は使えるツールになった。
blocks.translation: Its features are similar to those of RPG Maker 2000. Differences include side-view battles and automatic dungeon generation. It was originally plagued with bugs and harsh criticism, but after repeated updates, it became a usable tool, at least for the most part.

blocks.source: あまりのバグにちょっとした祭りになってました。今となってはなつかしい思い出です。
blocks.translation: There were so many bugs that it became something of an event. Now, it is a nostalgic memory.

blocks.source: ただ、バグを抜きにしても戦闘には気になる部分も。ダメージ表示が小さくて見にくかったり、全般的にタイミングがおかしくて落ち着かなかったり。レベルアップまでの経験値曲線が急でバランス調整がしにくいなど。細かいところに手が届かない感じ。これを使うなら2000のほうがお勧め。
blocks.translation: Even setting the bugs aside, there are some troubling aspects to its battles. The damage display is small and difficult to see, the timing is generally strange and unsettling, and the steep experience curve required to level up makes balancing difficult. It feels like the small details are beyond its reach. If you are going to use one of these, I recommend RPG Maker 2000 instead.

blocks.source: 高い画面解像度とＲＧＳＳ(Ruby言語)によって2000を凌駕する高い自由度が特徴で。反面、グラフィックの自作は大変。2000から削られた機能が存在するので、同じような機能が必要ならば、ＲＧＳＳによって自作しなければならないらしい。
blocks.translation: Its defining features are a high screen resolution and a degree of freedom surpassing RPG Maker 2000 through RGSS (the Ruby language). On the other hand, creating your own graphics is difficult. Some features from RPG Maker 2000 were removed, so apparently you have to recreate them with RGSS if you need similar functionality.

blocks.source: もっとも、他の人が作成したＲＧＳＳが配布されていたりするので、複雑なシステムを構築する際は2000よりも楽かもしれない。代表作は魔王物語物語や月夜に響くノクターン Rebirth辺りかな。これで作成した経験はないので、細かいことは控えときます。
blocks.translation: That said, RGSS scripts created by other people are sometimes available, so building complex systems may be easier than with RPG Maker 2000. Representative games include The Story of the Demon King and Nocturne Rebirth, Echoing in the Moonlit Night. I have no experience creating anything with this, so I will refrain from going into detail.

blocks.source: RPGツクールXPに類似だけど、2000に存在して、XPで削られた機能が色々と復活しているらしい。ただ、2000やXPにある機能の中で、使えない物もあるとのこと。やっぱり、よく知らないので細かいことは控えときます。
blocks.translation: It is similar to RPG Maker XP, but apparently many features that existed in RPG Maker 2000 and were removed in XP have been brought back. However, I hear that some features found in RPG Maker 2000 or XP cannot be used. Once again, I do not know it well enough, so I will refrain from going into detail.

blocks.source: 通称ウディタ。シルフェイド見聞録や幻想譚の制作者SmokingWOLF氏が作成。個人製作のフリーウェアであるが、その機能と自由度の高さは上記のツクールシリーズを超える。個人的にも大注目。解像度の切替。ユーザー定義のデータベースなど豊富な機能を誇る。他にもツクール2000でこんなのできたらいいのに思っていたことは大体できる気がする。反面、制作難易度の高さは作者も認めるところのよう。
blocks.translation: Commonly known as WOLF RPG Editor. It was created by SmokingWOLF, the developer of Sylphid's Chronicles and Illusionary Tales. Although it is freeware developed by an individual, its features and high degree of freedom surpass those of the RPG Maker series mentioned above. I am personally paying close attention to it. It boasts a wealth of features, including switchable resolutions and user-defined databases. It feels like you can do almost everything you wished you could do with RPG Maker 2000. On the other hand, even the creator seems to acknowledge that it has a high difficulty level for development.

blocks.source: 何はともあれ、フリーなので、気軽に挑戦してみるとよいかも知れない。僕の様なツクール脳に染まってしまった人間ではなく、ツクール未経験者の方が馴染みやすいという考え方も。開発中のソフトなので、今後も機能の改良が見込める。有志が解説サイトなどを作成しているのも心強い。
blocks.translation: In any case, it is free, so it may be worth giving it a try. Some people also believe that those who have never used RPG Maker may find it easier to get accustomed to than people like me whose thinking has been shaped by RPG Maker. Since the software is still in development, further improvements to its features can be expected. It is also reassuring that volunteers have created explanatory websites and other resources.

blocks.source: 開発ツールの紹介は以上。
blocks.translation: That concludes this introduction to development tools.

blocks.source: RPGツクールシリーズは企業の製品なので、もちろん有料なのだけど、精々１万円程度なので、学生の小遣いでも十分買える。それ１つで、何百何千と時間を潰せることを考えると、気にするほどのことはないはず。機能制限はあるけど、無料体験版も存在する。特にツクール2000は体験版の機能制限が緩いので、それなりの物が作成できる。
blocks.translation: The RPG Maker series consists of commercial products, so of course they cost money, but they are at most around 10,000 yen, which is affordable even with a student's allowance. Considering that one of them can provide hundreds or thousands of hours of entertainment, it should not be something to worry about. There are also free trial versions, although they have feature limitations. In particular, the trial version of RPG Maker 2000 has relatively few restrictions, allowing you to create reasonably substantial games.
